standard-dialogue.npc: What do you want? ...Oh, wait. I know! You're probably just like all the others, aren't you? After some fancy spell or potion from me, I bet!

standard-dialogue.player: What? No! At least, I don't think so. What sort of spells do you have?

standard-dialogue.npc: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy-Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?

standard-dialogue.player: That spell sounds very interesting, but I didn't mean to disturb you!

standard-dialogue.npc: Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
Now, if it's all the same, I am very busy at the moment. Unless you want something specific, please come back another time.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Oh, it's you again! Well, what is it this time?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.player: Do you have any jobs or quests that I could do for you?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Hah! There are plenty of things I need done, but something tells me you're not quite ready for them right now. Come back another time!

free-to-play.npc: Can't you see I'm very busy here? Be off with you!

using-items-on-surok-magis-any-item.npc: No thanks, I don't need that.

after-while-guthix-sleeps.player: How are you enjoying your cell, Surok?

after-while-guthix-sleeps.npc: You let me out of here! This isn't over...

after-while-guthix-sleeps.player: It's nice to see a little justice around here!
